== Summary ==
Slip “••••••Swarming Vulture Droid” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF file created 13 October 2026), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 52, 1624, 775)). Version [[Swarming Vulture Droid]] (Original). Not a recreation.
